## Products

Ascending/descending LOS, dE, dU, |dE|, interval and annualized rates, continuous cumulative displacement, quality and elevation profiles.

```python
dE, dU = invert_ascending_descending(los_asc, los_desc, geometry)
```

dU is not Eulerian elevation change or mass balance.
